name: GitHub
description: Developer platform whose REST API covers repositories, issues, actions, organizations and more.
auth_notes: Personal access tokens (classic and fine-grained), GitHub App installation and user tokens, OAuth apps, and GITHUB_TOKEN in Actions; sent as Bearer header. Username and password is not supported.
gate_detail: Any GitHub user can authenticate with tokens or create apps in Developer settings. Some endpoints (enterprise, billing, paid features) follow plan or admin requirements. No sandbox described.
api_scope: REST API described by an OpenAPI document, covering many areas including billing usage, budgets, CI status and app integrations; gh api CLI can call it.
mcp_notes: Remote GitHub MCP server uses one-click OAuth or a PAT; available to all GitHub users regardless of plan type.
blocker_detail: Org policies and enterprise settings can restrict tokens and apps, but individual developers can start immediately.

evidence.quote: You can authenticate to the REST API to access more endpoints and have a higher rate limit.
Authentication with username and password is not supported.
The GitHub REST API is fully described in an OpenAPI compliant document.
The GitHub MCP server is available to all GitHub users regardless of plan type.

issues: Webhooks and sandbox are not covered by the supplied pages.
Exact free-account token creation steps are not shown in the excerpts.
